rows.en: Damn Shocker… They got greedy, didn't they?
Damn Shocker… They got greedy, didn't they?
What do you mean?
What do you mean?
They mean to use his sister to lure out Dr. Shirakawa!
They mean to use his sister to lure out Dr. Shirakawa!
We have to rescue his sister before they do!
We have to rescue his sister before they do!
We have to save his sister before they do…
We have to save his sister before they do…

Let me do it! I'll get to the Makuu base before they do and rescue Dr. Shirakawa's sister!

I might find some clue about my father, too!!

Let me do it! I'll get to the Makuu base before they do and rescue Dr. Shirakawa's sister!

I might find some clue about my father, too!!
All right… We'll all back you up! Make sure you rescue his sister!
All right… We'll all back you up! Make sure you rescue his sister!

…!?

Ngh… Oh no!! Was I too late!? F-Father!!

…!?

Ngh… Oh no!! Was I too late!? F-Father!!

…!?

This is the place? All right, let's go down and take a look…

…!?

This is the place? All right, let's go down and take a look…

…!?

Taki, Dr. Shirakawa!? What are you doing here?

…!?

Taki, Dr. Shirakawa!? What are you doing here?

Gavan, you're all right!?

Actually, Dr. Shirakawa and I had something to take care of. So we got here a step ahead of you! Now, Dr. Shirakawa…

Mm… Machiko, it's dangerous, so stay back!

Let's show these people just how terrifying scientific weapons can be…
Brother…

Did you see that? The Danger Light… If science is used without thinking about the harm it can do, it will bring humanity misery.

Let's forget this invention!
Machiko… You have a wonderful brother.
Yes…

Dr. Shirakawa… The TDF's science group wants your cooperation!

Why not use your many research achievements for the sake of true peace?

Thank you…

I've heard the TDF's science group is an organization that brings together doctors from every specialized field, starting with Dr. Yuri. Please, let me cooperate…
Brother… Being able to do research for peace… your dream has really come true, hasn't it?
Yes…
What a weapon! The enemies right in front of us… turned to dust in an instant…
What a weapon! The enemies right in front of us… turned to dust in an instant…
Th-this is… my father's spacecraft!?
Th-this is… my father's spacecraft!?
Father, where are you? Father! Father!!
Father, where are you? Father! Father!!
So… he's not here after all? Father!!
So… he's not here after all? Father!!

What's this!?

A pendant of the same type as the one I have? Father was here…

What's this!?

A pendant of the same type as the one I have? Father was here…
Father, if you're alive, then surely… surely the day will come when we meet again… Father! Father…
Father, if you're alive, then surely… surely the day will come when we meet again… Father! Father… Father!!

His father Voicer was not there… But the joy of learning news of his father for the first time, and his rage at Makuu for carrying his father off, welled up into a storm of emotion that gripped Gavan's heart.
Believing that the day would surely come when they would meet again, Gavan left the deserted Makuu base behind.
Evil organizations springing up one after another… Monster armies growing ever stronger! Our Kamen Rider 1 and 2 were feeling the limits of their own abilities.

Hongo… You saw that weapon just now, right?

No, it's not just the weapons… The cyborgs, the Beast Aliens, the androids, they're all ramping up their fighting strength. Faster than we expected…
We've kept training with Oyassan Tachibana and Taki, but…

We just can't keep up with how fast the evil armies' science is advancing… huh.

If only we had the ability to build cyborgs ourselves…

…!?

Hm? Wait a second… That's it, there's that option!!

Hayato, there's a way for us to power up for sure.
What!? How?
What did you say!?
Huh?
Have you lost your minds??? You can't be serious! It's far too dangerous!

…………

You're prepared for the danger, then… Hongo, Hayato, anyway, explain it to us in detail.

…………

You're prepared for the danger… right? Anyway, please explain it in detail.

Yes…

You've all felt how tough the cyborgs and androids have become lately, haven't you?

With our combat abilities as they are, it's only a matter of time before monsters that exceed Kamen Rider's abilities appear…

Every organization is frantically analyzing our combat abilities, after all.

If the enemies that show up from now on have fundamentally different physical abilities, then no matter how much Hongo and I train, the result is obvious.
That's why we need to be remodified, to raise our physical and combat abilities.
I can see where you're coming from, but… how on earth would you do it?
We'll undergo remodification surgery at Shocker!
Wh-what!?
We're going to put on a little act. Don't worry, Goro…

But… what about the brain modification?

If Shocker catches you now, this time they'll do the brain modification surgery for sure.
That's why we have comrades, so that doesn't happen! Please, we're asking you to take this on!
We believe in all of you… Isn't that enough?

…………

What'll we do, [HERO2]?
"They've made up their minds this far… let's do it!" "It's too dangerous… they'd better not."
All right… If you're that set on it, let's do it! But there's no guarantee you'll survive!
Thanks, Goro…
I thought so… Won't you two reconsider? I really don't think it'll work…

Yeah… We understand how you all feel.

It may be a tough fight, but we'll overcome the difference in strength with our effort and teamwork! Right, Hayato?

…………

What'll we do, [HERO2]?
"Let's give it a try! For their sake too…" "It's too dangerous… they'd better not."
Hayato!!
Hayato!!
Hongo!!
Hongo!!
Gavan!!
Gavan!!
